title: Measure the 60-second core compile budget on Linux under load and cut what measures as a real lever
goal: Measure cold and warm build, test, startup and change-to-useful-result times of Susi core separately on the CEO's Linux x86_64 laptop under real multi-agent load, identify the critical path and levers, land any lever that measures better without removing capability, and record the numbers.

results.change: Cargo.toml [profile.dev] codegen-units 256 -> 16, equal to [profile.test] (16 since 487c36292), so build and test share every dependency artifact. No dependency, source or ceiling change.
results.test_after_build_no_run: cargo test -p susi-gmcp --no-run after cargo build -p susi: 256 units 78.2 s, 162 crates compiled; 16 units 32.6 s, 49 crates compiled
results.warm_build_s: no-op 0.22/0.23; touch susi-gmcp source 4.4-8.0 (256) vs 4.3/4.9 (16); touch src/main.rs 2.8-8.1 (256) vs 2.1/2.5 (16); touch susi-core lib.rs 6.5-8.5 (256) vs 6.2/10.4 (16)
results.gmcp_tests: cargo test -p susi-gmcp: 222 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored over 4 binaries; 17.1 s (doc-tests compiling) and 5.7 s warm
results.change_to_result_s: one-line susi-gmcp edit + cargo build -p susi + cargo test -p susi-gmcp, both warm: 22.6/29.9/19.8 (256) vs 23.3/25.4/19.9 (16)
results.startup: target/debug/susi --version 40-61 ms; susi start to all ports listening 0.75 s (fresh isolated home, SUSI_PORT_OFFSET 3000) and 0.39 s; susi stop 0.30 s; start -> MCP initialize -> tools/list 0.52 s
results.critical_path_linux: syn(host) -> serde_derive -> serde -> susi-error -> susi-config -> susi-core -> {susi-gmcp | gawd-agents -> gawd-swarm -> susi-gawd | susi-gemi} -> susi-daemon -> susi bin
results.verification: cargo fmt --all --check exit 0; cargo clippy -p susi --offline --locked -- -D warnings exit 0; orphan_sources 3/0, lean_core_ceilings 2/0, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5/0; architecture_tests 42 passed, 1 failed (cross_crate_source_mounts_only_decrease, pre-existing, crates/susi-harness/tests/native_link.rs, owned by unblock); xtask ci_workflow_perf 27/0

limitations: Every number is under real multi-agent load (load average 7-53); none is an idle baseline, and wall varies by up to 2x between runs with no source change.
The cold-build effect of 16 units is within load noise (4 of 5 alternated pairs faster); it is recorded as no regression, not as a budget cut.
The 60 s budget is not met on Linux: best cold run 75.6 s.

Runs with CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_CODEGEN_UNITS overriding the committed setting are kept out of .agents/build-time.jsonl because the tool records only the commit; they are in this record and in docs/lean-core.md.
architecture_tests is left out of accept.cmd because of the pre-existing native_link.rs failure that another agent owns.

provenance.host: CEO laptop, CachyOS Linux x86_64, 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13850HX, 28 logical CPUs, 219 GiB RAM
provenance.worktree: susi-agent-buildtime, branch local-agent/buildtime, own target directory
